# E-commerce Customer Support Agent

A multi-agent customer support system that showcases **MongoDB as both the operational database and the conversation memory backend** for AI agents built with the [OpenAI Agents SDK](https://openai.github.io/openai-agents-python/).

---

## What this demonstrates

| MongoDB capability | Where it appears |
|---|---|
| **Document model** — embedded line items in orders | `get_order_status` returns a complete order in one query, no joins |
| **Flexible schema** — orders gain fields as they move through states | Return metadata (`return_reason`, `return_requested_at`) added only when needed |
| **Full-text search** — weighted index across title, tags, and content | `search_knowledge_base` ranks articles by relevance |
| **Atomic updates** — `$set` + `$inc` for safe concurrent writes | `initiate_return` updates order status and loyalty calculations atomically |
| **Persistent session memory** — `MongoDBSession` stores every conversation turn | Conversations survive process restarts; customers resume mid-thread |

---

## Architecture

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    User([User message]) --> Triage

    subgraph SDK["OpenAI Agents SDK — Runner.run(..., session=MongoDBSession(...))"]
        Triage["Triage Agent\nidentify_customer()"]
        Order["Order Support Agent\nget_order_status\nget_order_history\ninitiate_return"]
        KB["Knowledge Base Agent\nsearch_knowledge_base\nget_product_info"]

        Triage -- handoff --> Order
        Triage -- handoff --> KB
    end

    subgraph MongoDB["MongoDB: ecommerce_support"]
        customers[("customers\nname · email · tier")]
        orders[("orders\norder_id · status\nitems: [{name,qty}]\ntotal")]
        products[("products\nsku · name\nprice · inventory")]
        articles[("support_articles\ntitle · content · tags\n[$text full-text index]")]
        sessions[("agent_sessions\nagent_messages\n— MongoDBSession —")]
    end

    Triage -- identify_customer --> customers
    Order -- order queries --> orders
    Order -- product lookups --> products
    KB -- $text search --> articles
    KB -- product info --> products
    SDK -- persist conversation --> sessions
```

---

## Use case

A customer contacts support through any channel (web chat, mobile app, internal tool). The system:

1. **Identifies the customer** from MongoDB and pre-loads their loyalty tier.
2. **Routes** their request to the right specialist agent via handoffs.
3. **Queries live data** — order status with embedded line items, real inventory counts, KB articles ranked by text-search relevance.
4. **Applies business logic** — loyalty tier refund bonuses, eligibility checks, atomic status updates.
5. **Persists the conversation** in MongoDB so the customer can return later (even after a server restart) and the agent picks up exactly where they left off.

### Why this matters for AI applications

**Without session persistence**, every conversation starts cold. Users re-explain their problem, the agent re-queries what it already found, and the experience feels disconnected from the customer's real history.

**With `MongoDBSession`**, the full conversation thread — including every tool call result and agent response — is stored durably. A customer who started a return process yesterday and comes back today continues seamlessly. At scale, this works across any number of backend instances because MongoDB handles the shared state.

**Without the document model**, an order with 10 line items requires a JOIN across tables. MongoDB returns the complete order — items, totals, tracking — in a single query, which maps naturally to the dictionary the agent tool returns.

---

## Prerequisites

- Python 3.10+
- MongoDB running locally (`mongod`) or a [MongoDB Atlas](https://www.mongodb.com/cloud/atlas) connection string
- An OpenAI API key
---

## Setup

### 1. Install dependencies

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

### 2. Configure environment variables

```bash
cp env.example .env
# Edit .env and set your values:
#   OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-...
#   MONGODB_URI=mongodb://localhost:27017   # or Atlas URI
```

### 3. Seed the database

```bash
python seed_data.py
```

Expected output:

```
Connecting to MongoDB at mongodb://localhost:27017 ...
Connected. Seeding 'ecommerce_support' ...

  ✓ 3 customers
  ✓ 5 products
  ✓ 5 orders (with embedded line items)
  ✓ 7 support articles (full-text indexed)

Database 'ecommerce_support' is ready.

Demo accounts:
  alice@example.com              Gold tier
  bob@example.com                Standard tier
  carol@example.com              Platinum tier
```

### 4. Run the demo

```bash
python main.py
```

---

## Walkthrough

Start with `alice@example.com` (Gold member with two orders):

```
Your email address (or press Enter for demo): alice@example.com
Welcome back, Alice Johnson! (Gold member)

[Starting new conversation — history will persist in MongoDB]

You: Hi, I need help with my recent orders
```

The Triage Agent greets Alice (already identified from MongoDB) and hands off to Order Support:

```
Triage Agent: Hello Alice! I can see you're a Gold member. Let me check your orders.
  [Routing to Order Support Agent]

Order Support Agent: Here's your recent order history:
  • ORD-1001  Delivered  $1,349.98  (2025-03-02)
  • ORD-1002  Shipped    $199.99    (2025-04-13)
```

Ask about returning a delivered order:

```
You: I'd like to return ORD-1001, the laptop setup I bought
Order Support Agent: I can process that return for you. What's the reason for the return?

You: It's not powerful enough for my video editing work
Order Support Agent: Return initiated for order ORD-1001.
Reason: Not powerful enough for video editing work
Estimated refund: $1,484.98 (includes 10% Gold loyalty bonus)
```

Ask a policy question — the agent routes to Knowledge Base:

```
You: What's your warranty policy?
  [Routing to Knowledge Base Agent]

Knowledge Base Agent: All products carry a 1-year limited warranty against manufacturing 
defects. Laptops are eligible for an optional 2-year extended warranty...
```

**Quit and restart** — the conversation history is in MongoDB:

```
You: quit
Thank you for contacting support. Goodbye!

$ python main.py
Your email address (or press Enter for demo): alice@example.com
Welcome back, Alice Johnson! (Gold member)

[Resuming previous conversation — 12 messages stored in MongoDB]
```

The agent knows about the return, the warranty question, and everything else.

---

## MongoDB collections at a glance

After running the demo, inspect the data:

```javascript
// In mongosh or MongoDB Compass:
use ecommerce_support

// Customer document
db.customers.findOne({ email: "alice@example.com" })
// { name: "Alice Johnson", loyalty_tier: "gold", ... }

// Order with embedded line items — no joins required
db.orders.findOne({ order_id: "ORD-1001" })
// {
//   order_id: "ORD-1001",
//   status: "return_requested",        <-- updated by the agent
//   return_reason: "Not powerful ...", <-- new field, flexible schema
//   items: [
//     { name: "Laptop Pro X1", qty: 1, unit_price: 1299.99 },
//     { name: "USB-C Hub 7-in-1", qty: 1, unit_price: 49.99 }
//   ],
//   total: 1349.98
// }

// Conversation history stored by MongoDBSession
db.agent_messages.find({ session_id: "support_alice_at_example_com" }).count()
// 12

// Full-text search used by the Knowledge Base Agent
db.support_articles.find({ $text: { $search: "return refund gold" } },
  { score: { $meta: "textScore" }, title: 1 }).sort({ score: { $meta: "textScore" } })
```

---

## Integrating into your application

### Connection sharing

Create **one `AsyncMongoClient` per application process** and share it across all sessions. This reuses the connection pool efficiently.

```python
# app startup
mongo_client = AsyncMongoClient(os.environ["MONGODB_URI"])
db = mongo_client["your_db"]

# per request / per user
session = MongoDBSession(
    session_id=f"support_{user_id}",
    client=mongo_client,   # shared client, not owned by the session
    database="your_db",
)
```

### Session isolation

Each `session_id` is completely isolated in MongoDB. Use a deterministic ID per user or conversation:

```python
# User-scoped (all conversations for a user share history)
session_id = f"user_{user_id}"

# Conversation-scoped (fresh history per support ticket)
session_id = f"ticket_{ticket_id}"
```

### FastAPI example

```python
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from fastapi import FastAPI, Request
from pymongo.asynchronous.mongo_client import AsyncMongoClient
from agents import Agent, Runner
from agents.extensions.memory import MongoDBSession

@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    app.state.mongo = AsyncMongoClient(os.environ["MONGODB_URI"])
    yield
    await app.state.mongo.close()

app = FastAPI(lifespan=lifespan)

@app.post("/chat/{user_id}")
async def chat(user_id: str, body: dict, request: Request):
    session = MongoDBSession(
        session_id=f"support_{user_id}",
        client=request.app.state.mongo,
        database="ecommerce_support",
    )
    ctx = await build_context(request.app.state.mongo, user_id)
    result = await Runner.run(
        triage_agent,
        input=body["message"],
        context=ctx,
        session=session,
    )
    return {"reply": ItemHelpers.text_message_output(result.new_items[-1])}
```

### MongoDB Atlas for production

Swap the URI for an Atlas connection string to get:

- **Atlas Search** — vector search and semantic ranking on support articles (upgrade from `$text`)
- **Change Streams** — real-time notifications when order status changes
- **Time Series collections** — for conversation analytics and agent performance metrics
- **Automatic scaling** — no connection pool tuning needed

```python
MONGODB_URI = "mongodb+srv://user:pass@cluster.mongodb.net/?retryWrites=true&w=majority"
```

---

## Extending the demo

| Idea | What to add |
|---|---|
| **Vector search on KB articles** | Store embeddings alongside articles; use Atlas `$vectorSearch` in `search_knowledge_base` |
| **Proactive notifications** | Watch the `orders` collection with Change Streams; trigger agents when status changes |
| **Analytics dashboard** | Aggregate `agent_messages` by session, intent, and resolution time |
| **Multi-tenant isolation** | Add a `tenant_id` field to all collections and pass it as a filter in every query |
| **Human-in-the-loop approvals** | Use `needs_approval=True` on `initiate_return` and serialize state to MongoDB between turns |

---

## Files

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [`main.py`](main.py) | Interactive demo — agents, tools, session wiring |
| [`seed_data.py`](seed_data.py) | One-time database seeding with indexes |
| [`requirements.txt`](requirements.txt) | Python dependencies |
| [`env.example`](env.example) | Environment variable template |

Run once before starting main.py:

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Seeding logic
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


async def seed() -> None:
    print(f"Connecting to MongoDB at {MONGODB_URI} ...")
    client = AsyncMongoClient(MONGODB_URI)
    db = client[DB_NAME]

    try:
        await client.admin.command("ping")
        print(f"Connected. Seeding '{DB_NAME}' ...\n")
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"Connection failed: {exc}")
        await client.close()
        return

    # Drop existing collections for a clean slate
    for name in ["customers", "products", "orders", "support_articles"]:
        await db.drop_collection(name)

    # --- Customers ---
    await db.customers.insert_many(CUSTOMERS)
    await db.customers.create_index("email", unique=True)
    print(f"  ✓ {len(CUSTOMERS)} customers")

    # Build email → ObjectId map so orders can reference customers
    email_to_id: dict[str, str] = {}
    async for doc in db.customers.find({}, {"email": 1}):
        email_to_id[doc["email"]] = str(doc["_id"])

    # --- Products ---
    await db.products.insert_many(PRODUCTS)
    await db.products.create_index("sku", unique=True)
    print(f"  ✓ {len(PRODUCTS)} products")

    # --- Orders (embed customer_id, remove helper email field) ---
    orders_to_insert = []
    for o in ORDERS:
        doc = {**o, "customer_id": email_to_id[o["customer_email"]]}
        doc.pop("customer_email")
        orders_to_insert.append(doc)

    await db.orders.insert_many(orders_to_insert)
    await db.orders.create_index("order_id", unique=True)
    await db.orders.create_index(
        [("customer_id", ASCENDING), ("created_at", DESCENDING)]
    )
    print(f"  ✓ {len(ORDERS)} orders (with embedded line items)")

    # --- Support articles with weighted full-text index ---
    await db.support_articles.insert_many(SUPPORT_ARTICLES)
    await db.support_articles.create_index(
        [("title", TEXT), ("tags", TEXT), ("content", TEXT)],
        weights={"title": 10, "tags": 5, "content": 1},
        name="support_articles_text",
    )
    print(f"  ✓ {len(SUPPORT_ARTICLES)} support articles (full-text indexed)")

    print(f"\nDatabase '{DB_NAME}' is ready.")
    print("\nDemo accounts:")
    for c in CUSTOMERS:
        print(f"  {c['email']:<30}  {c['loyalty_tier'].title()} tier")

    await client.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(seed())

"""
E-commerce Customer Support Agent

Demonstrates MongoDB as both the operational database and the session memory
backend for a multi-agent support system built on the OpenAI Agents SDK.

Collections used:
  customers        — customer profiles
  products         — product catalog with inventory
  orders           — orders with embedded line items (document model)
  support_articles — knowledge base with full-text index
  agent_sessions   — session metadata (managed by MongoDBSession)
  agent_messages   — conversation history (managed by MongoDBSession)

Run seed_data.py first, then: python main.py
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import os
import uuid
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from typing import Any

from dotenv import load_dotenv
from pymongo.asynchronous.mongo_client import AsyncMongoClient

from agents import (
    Agent,
    HandoffOutputItem,
    ItemHelpers,
    MessageOutputItem,
    RunContextWrapper,
    Runner,
    ToolCallItem,
    ToolCallOutputItem,
    function_tool,
    trace,
)
from agents.extensions.handoff_prompt import RECOMMENDED_PROMPT_PREFIX
from agents.extensions.memory import MongoDBSession

load_dotenv()

MONGODB_URI = os.environ.get("MONGODB_URI", "mongodb://localhost:27017")
DB_NAME = "ecommerce_support"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Runtime context (not stored in MongoDB — populated fresh each session)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass
class SupportContext:
    db: Any  # AsyncDatabase — typed as Any to avoid optional pymongo type import
    customer_id: str | None = None
    customer_name: str | None = None
    loyalty_tier: str = "standard"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Tools — Triage Agent
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


@function_tool
async def identify_customer(ctx: RunContextWrapper[SupportContext], email: str) -> str:
    """Look up a customer account by email address."""
    customer = await ctx.context.db.customers.find_one({"email": email.lower().strip()})
    if not customer:
        return f"No account found for '{email}'. The customer may need to register."

    ctx.context.customer_id = str(customer["_id"])
    ctx.context.customer_name = customer["name"]
    ctx.context.loyalty_tier = customer.get("loyalty_tier", "standard")

    return (
        f"Account verified: {customer['name']} "
        f"({customer.get('loyalty_tier', 'standard').title()} member, "
        f"joined {customer.get('member_since', 'N/A')})"
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Tools — Order Support Agent
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


@function_tool
async def get_order_status(ctx: RunContextWrapper[SupportContext], order_id: str) -> str:
    """Fetch the current status and full details of a specific order."""
    query: dict = {"order_id": order_id.upper().strip()}
    if ctx.context.customer_id:
        query["customer_id"] = ctx.context.customer_id

    order = await ctx.context.db.orders.find_one(query)
    if not order:
        return f"Order {order_id.upper()} not found."

    items_summary = ", ".join(
        f"{item['name']} ×{item['qty']}" for item in order.get("items", [])
    )
    tracking = order.get("tracking_number") or "Not yet assigned"
    status_display = order["status"].replace("_", " ").upper()

    return (
        f"Order {order['order_id']}  —  {status_display}\n"
        f"Items   : {items_summary}\n"
        f"Total   : ${order['total']:.2f}\n"
        f"Placed  : {order.get('created_at', 'N/A')}\n"
        f"Tracking: {tracking}"
    )


@function_tool
async def get_order_history(ctx: RunContextWrapper[SupportContext]) -> str:
    """Retrieve the last five orders for the identified customer."""
    if not ctx.context.customer_id:
        return "Customer not yet identified. Please ask for their email address first."

    cursor = (
        ctx.context.db.orders.find({"customer_id": ctx.context.customer_id})
        .sort("created_at", -1)
        .limit(5)
    )
    orders = await cursor.to_list(5)

    if not orders:
        return f"No orders found for {ctx.context.customer_name}."

    lines = [f"Order history for {ctx.context.customer_name}:"]
    for o in orders:
        status = o["status"].replace("_", " ").title()
        lines.append(f"  • {o['order_id']}  {status}  ${o['total']:.2f}  ({o.get('created_at', 'N/A')})")
    return "\n".join(lines)


@function_tool
async def initiate_return(
    ctx: RunContextWrapper[SupportContext], order_id: str, reason: str
) -> str:
    """
    Initiate a return for a delivered order.

    Gold and Platinum loyalty members receive a bonus on their refund.
    Only delivered orders are eligible; confirm the reason before calling this tool.
    """
    if not ctx.context.customer_id:
        return "Customer not yet identified. Please ask for their email address first."

    order = await ctx.context.db.orders.find_one(
        {"order_id": order_id.upper(), "customer_id": ctx.context.customer_id}
    )
    if not order:
        return f"Order {order_id.upper()} not found for this customer."
    if order["status"] not in ("delivered", "completed"):
        current = order["status"].replace("_", " ")
        return (
            f"Cannot return order {order_id.upper()} — status is '{current}'. "
            "Only delivered orders are eligible."
        )

    await ctx.context.db.orders.update_one(
        {"order_id": order_id.upper()},
        {
            "$set": {
                "status": "return_requested",
                "return_reason": reason,
                "return_requested_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            }
        },
    )

    refund = order["total"]
    tier = ctx.context.loyalty_tier
    bonus_pct = {"gold": 10, "platinum": 15}.get(tier, 0)
    if bonus_pct:
        refund *= 1 + bonus_pct / 100

    msg = (
        f"Return initiated for order {order['order_id']}.\n"
        f"Reason: {reason}\n"
        f"Estimated refund: ${refund:.2f}"
    )
    if bonus_pct:
        msg += f" (includes {bonus_pct}% {tier.title()} loyalty bonus)"
    return msg

@function_tool
async def search_knowledge_base(ctx: RunContextWrapper[SupportContext], query: str) -> str:
    """
    Search support articles using MongoDB full-text search.

    Indexes are weighted: title (10×) > tags (5×) > content (1×).
    Returns the top 3 results ranked by relevance.
    """
    cursor = (
        ctx.context.db.support_articles.find(
            {"$text": {"$search": query}},
            {"score": {"$meta": "textScore"}, "title": 1, "content": 1, "category": 1},
        )
        .sort([("score", {"$meta": "textScore"})])
        .limit(3)
    )
    articles = await cursor.to_list(3)

    if not articles:
        return f"No support articles found for: '{query}'"

    return "\n\n---\n\n".join(
        f"[{a['category']}] {a['title']}\n{a['content']}" for a in articles
    )


@function_tool
async def get_product_info(ctx: RunContextWrapper[SupportContext], product_name: str) -> str:
    """Look up product details and live inventory from the catalog."""
    product = await ctx.context.db.products.find_one(
        {"name": {"$regex": product_name, "$options": "i"}}
    )
    if not product:
        return f"No product matching '{product_name}' found in the catalog."

    stock = f"In stock ({product['inventory']} units)" if product["inventory"] > 0 else "Out of stock"
    return (
        f"{product['name']}  (SKU: {product['sku']})\n"
        f"Price       : ${product['price']:.2f}\n"
        f"Category    : {product['category']}\n"
        f"Availability: {stock}\n"
        f"{product['description']}"
    )

order_agent: Agent[SupportContext] = Agent(
    name="Order Support Agent",
    handoff_description="Handles order status lookups, order history, and return requests.",
    instructions=f"""{RECOMMENDED_PROMPT_PREFIX}
You are an order support specialist with direct access to the order database.

Routine:
1. If the customer has not been identified yet, ask the triage agent to do so first.
2. Use get_order_status to retrieve details for a specific order.
3. Use get_order_history to show all recent orders for the customer.
4. Use initiate_return for return requests — confirm order ID and reason before calling.
5. Mention the loyalty tier refund bonus proactively when processing returns.
6. For questions outside orders (policies, products), hand off to the Knowledge Base Agent.
7. For account issues, hand off to the Triage Agent.
""",
    tools=[get_order_status, get_order_history, initiate_return],
    model="gpt-5-nano",
)

kb_agent: Agent[SupportContext] = Agent(
    name="Knowledge Base Agent",
    handoff_description="Answers policy questions and provides product information.",
    instructions=f"""{RECOMMENDED_PROMPT_PREFIX}
You are a product and policy specialist.

Routine:
1. Use search_knowledge_base for shipping, return policy, warranty, loyalty, or how-to questions.
2. Use get_product_info for pricing, availability, and compatibility questions.
3. Combine results from both tools when the question spans both areas.
4. For order-specific questions (status, returns), hand off to the Order Support Agent.
5. For account identification or other issues, hand off to the Triage Agent.
""",
    tools=[search_knowledge_base, get_product_info],
    model="gpt-5-nano",
)

triage_agent: Agent[SupportContext] = Agent(
    name="Triage Agent",
    handoff_description="First point of contact — identifies customers and routes requests.",
    instructions=f"""{RECOMMENDED_PROMPT_PREFIX}
You are the first point of contact for customer support.

Routine:
1. Greet the customer warmly.
2. If the customer is not yet identified, use identify_customer with their email address.
3. Determine the nature of their request and hand off to the right specialist:
   - Order status, history, returns  →  Order Support Agent
   - Policies, product info, how-to  →  Knowledge Base Agent
4. Handle simple clarifying questions yourself without handing off.
""",
    tools=[identify_customer],
    handoffs=[order_agent, kb_agent],
    model="gpt-5-nano",
)

# Allow specialists to escalate back to triage
order_agent.handoffs.append(triage_agent)
kb_agent.handoffs.append(triage_agent)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Entry point
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


async def main() -> None:
    print("=" * 60)
    print("  E-commerce Customer Support")
    print("  Powered by MongoDB + OpenAI Agents SDK")
    print("=" * 60)

    mongo_client = AsyncMongoClient(MONGODB_URI)
    db = mongo_client[DB_NAME]

    try:
        await mongo_client.admin.command("ping")
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"\nCannot connect to MongoDB ({MONGODB_URI}):\n  {exc}")
        print("\nMake sure MongoDB is running and run `python seed_data.py` first.")
        await mongo_client.close()
        return

    print(f"\nConnected to MongoDB  ({MONGODB_URI}/{DB_NAME})")
    print("Commands: 'quit' to exit, 'clear' to reset conversation history\n")

    raw_email = input("Your email address (or press Enter for demo): ").strip().lower()
    email = raw_email or "alice@example.com"
    if not raw_email:
        print(f"Using demo account: {email}")

    # Pre-populate context from MongoDB so the agent knows who it's talking to
    # from the very first message — without needing to call identify_customer again.
    customer = await db.customers.find_one({"email": email})
    ctx = SupportContext(db=db)
    if customer:
        ctx.customer_id = str(customer["_id"])
        ctx.customer_name = customer["name"]
        ctx.loyalty_tier = customer.get("loyalty_tier", "standard")
        print(f"\nWelcome back, {customer['name']}! ({ctx.loyalty_tier.title()} member)\n")
    else:
        print("\nNew visitor — the triage agent will identify your account.\n")

    # One MongoDBSession per email address — conversation history persists
    # across process restarts automatically.
    session_id = f"support_{email.replace('@', '_at_').replace('.', '_')}"
    session = MongoDBSession(
        session_id=session_id,
        client=mongo_client,
        database=DB_NAME,
    )

    if not await session.ping():
        print("Warning: MongoDB session storage is unavailable.")

    existing = await session.get_items()
    if existing:
        print(f"[Resuming previous conversation — {len(existing)} messages stored in MongoDB]\n")
    else:
        print("[Starting new conversation — history will persist in MongoDB]\n")

    current_agent: Agent[SupportContext] = triage_agent
    conversation_id = uuid.uuid4().hex[:16]

    while True:
        try:
            user_input = input("You: ").strip()
        except (EOFError, KeyboardInterrupt):
            print("\nGoodbye!")
            break

        if not user_input:
            continue
        if user_input.lower() == "quit":
            print("\nThank you for contacting support. Goodbye!")
            break
        if user_input.lower() == "clear":
            await session.clear_session()
            current_agent = triage_agent
            print("[Conversation history cleared from MongoDB.]\n")
            continue

        with trace("Customer Support", group_id=conversation_id):
            result = await Runner.run(
                current_agent,
                input=user_input,
                context=ctx,
                session=session,  # MongoDB stores every turn automatically
            )

        for item in result.new_items:
            if isinstance(item, MessageOutputItem):
                text = ItemHelpers.text_message_output(item)
                if text:
                    print(f"\n{item.agent.name}: {text}\n")
            elif isinstance(item, HandoffOutputItem):
                print(f"  [Routing to {item.target_agent.name}]\n")
            elif isinstance(item, (ToolCallItem, ToolCallOutputItem)):
                pass  # Suppress tool noise; remove this line to see raw tool calls

        current_agent = result.last_agent

    await session.close()
    await mongo_client.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
